pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Hallo" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. sorry, excuse me
   C. hello (friendly)
   D. no

2. What does "Bitte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. please
   B. see you tomorrow
   C. bye (friendly)
   D. good night

3. What does "die Eltern" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. friend
   B. family
   C. parents
   D. daughter

4. What does "immer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tomorrow
   B. always
   C. now
   D. yesterday

5. What does "gestern" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. always
   B. tomorrow
   C. yesterday
   D. often

6. Which sentence tells that someone likes rice and beans? (1 mark)
   A. Ich habe kein Reis.
   B. Ich esse gern Reis und Bohnen.
   C. Wo ist der Reis?
   D. Ich koche Reis und Bohnen nicht.

7. What does "die Orange" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. potato
   B. lunch
   C. water
   D. orange

8. What does "das Ohr" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tummy
   B. mouth
   C. finger
   D. ear

9. Which word has the sound "oy"? (1 mark)
   A. heute
   B. Haus
   C. nein
   D. Tier

10. How is the letter "ß" pronounced? (1 mark)
   A. like a strong ss
   B. like b
   C. like sh
   D. like z

11. What does "Guten Morgen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. please
   B. good morning
   C. good day (daytime greeting)
   D. sorry, excuse me

12. What does "die Tochter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. daughter
   B. sister
   C. brother
   D. father

13. In the guessing game, which sentence gives the answer "It is my father"? (1 mark)
   A. Das ist meine Mutter.
   B. Das ist mein Bruder.
   C. Das ist mein Vater.
   D. Das ist meine Oma.

14. What is the plural of "die Gabel"? (1 mark)
   A. die Gabels
   B. die Gabeln
   C. die Gabel
   D. die Gabeler

15. Which German word is the number 17? (1 mark)
   A. siebzehn
   B. zwei
   C. sieben
   D. elf

16. What does "sonnig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cool
   B. sunny
   C. dry
   D. foggy

17. Which German word means "under"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. hinter
   B. unter
   C. in
   D. über

18. Which German word means "between"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. neben
   B. zwischen
   C. auf
   D. hinter

19. Which German word means "old"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. alt
   B. klein
   C. fleißig
   D. lustig

20. Which little word goes with the noun "Tante"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. den
   D. das

21. What is the plural of "der Stuhl"? (1 mark)
   A. die Stühle
   B. die Stuhle
   C. die Stuhls
   D. die Stuhler

22. Which German word or phrase means "shower"? (1 mark)
   A. die Dusche
   B. der Kühlschrank
   C. die Wand
   D. der Tisch

23. What is the plural of "die Kerze"? (1 mark)
   A. die Kerzer
   B. die Kerzes
   C. die Kerze
   D. die Kerzen

24. Which form completes "Obst ___ gesund"? (1 mark)
   A. bist
   B. sind
   C. bin
   D. ist

25. Which German word or phrase means "supper"? (1 mark)
   A. der Käse
   B. der Mais
   C. das Abendessen
   D. die Tomate

26. What is the plural of "das Ei"? (1 mark)
   A. die Eien
   B. die Eie
   C. die Eier
   D. die Eis

27. Which little word goes with the noun "Schulter"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. die
   D. den

28. What does "Das sind meine Augen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. These are my ears
   B. These are my eyes
   C. That is my nose
   D. This is my eye

29. What does "windig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cool
   B. wet
   C. hot
   D. windy

30. Which German word means "warm"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. wolkig
   B. nass
   C. warm
   D. neblig

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the German words with der, die or das for: eye, neck, friend, uncle. (4 marks)

32. Write the German words with der, die or das for: watermelon, pot. (2 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: leg, house. (2 marks)

34. Write the German words with der, die or das for: thunderstorm, candle. (2 marks)

35. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cocoa, party. (2 marks)

36. Write three sentences that say which item is in which room. (3 marks)

37. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bathroom, potato, milk. (3 marks)

38. Write the German words with der, die or das for: toe, song, juice, egg, water. (5 marks)

39. Write your own Elfchen about a birthday. Check that it has 11 words. (4 marks)

40. Write the German words with der, die or das for: rice, breakfast, table, fridge, kitchen. (5 marks)

41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cabbage or kale, toilet, fog. (3 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear, cloud, cake. (5 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: plate, lamp, tomato, knee. (4 marks)

44. Write two German sentences about what you would like to do on your birthday. (2 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: orange, lunch, carrot, grandfather. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — hello (friendly)
   Hallo means hello (friendly).

2. A — please
   Bitte means please.

3. C — parents
   die Eltern means parents.

4. B — always
   immer means always.

5. C — yesterday
   gestern means yesterday.

6. B — Ich esse gern Reis und Bohnen.
   gern shows that the person likes it.

7. D — orange
   die Orange means orange.

8. D — ear
   das Ohr means ear.

9. A — heute
   The letters eu sound like oy, so heute is HOY-te.

10. A — like a strong ss
   ß is called Eszett and sounds like ss.

11. B — good morning
   Guten Morgen means good morning.

12. A — daughter
   die Tochter means daughter.

13. C — Das ist mein Vater.
   Vater means father.

14. B — die Gabeln
   The plural of die Gabel is die Gabeln.

15. A — siebzehn
   17 in German is siebzehn.

16. B — sunny
   sonnig means sunny.

17. B — unter
   under in German is unter.

18. B — zwischen
   between in German is zwischen.

19. A — alt
   old in German is alt.

20. B — die
   It is die Tante, so the little word is die.

21. A — die Stühle
   The plural of der Stuhl is die Stühle.

22. A — die Dusche
   shower in German is die Dusche.

23. D — die Kerzen
   The plural of die Kerze is die Kerzen.

24. D — ist
   Obst is treated as one group, so we say ist.

25. C — das Abendessen
   supper in German is das Abendessen.

26. C — die Eier
   The plural of das Ei is die Eier.

27. C — die
   It is die Schulter, so the little word is die.

28. B — These are my eyes
   sind is used for more than one thing.

29. D — windy
   windig means windy.

30. C — warm
   warm in German is warm.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Auge, der Hals, der Freund, der Onkel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Wassermelone, der Topf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Bein, das Haus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gewitter, die Kerze.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Kakao, die Party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Zeh, das Lied, der Saft, das Ei, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Kuchen / Süße Kerzen / Wir singen zusammen / Ich bin heute zehn / Danke!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the 1-2-3-4-1 pattern, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for capital letters, 1 mark for meaning.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, das Frühstück, der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr, die Wolke, der Kuchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Teller, die Lampe, die Tomate, das Knie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich möchte tanzen. Ich möchte Kuchen essen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Orange, das Mittagessen, die Karotte, der Opa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).
